messages:
Maya (product): Quick sync — finalizing launch guardrails & acceptance criteria for the predictive-routing rollout. Need signoff on scope, tenant pin behavior, and rollback heuristics before PRD freeze EOD Fri.

Eli (eng-platform): Propose EU-only start, 5% traffic cap, dedicated pool route. Also need autoscale floor for canary pods.

Sam (eng-runtime): +1. Add enforced 95p latency SLO <= 120ms for canary. If violated, automatic fallback to baseline model variant.

Ravi (eng-sre): Draft rollback triggers:
- error_rate > 1% sustained over 5m
- customer_impacting_errors increase (pager) OR
- 95p latency regression > 50ms sustained 10m
If any trigger, trigger immediate rollback and notify oncall.

Jana (customer-success): ACME legal asked tenant pinning at launch. Must guarantee pinned tenants never routed to experiment variant.

Maya (product): Acceptance criteria (proposed):
1) Pin API exists + e2e test
2) Rollout policy supports tenant-level opt-out
3) Metrics dashboard shows pinned tenant isolation
4) Runbook + rollback steps documented

Eli (eng-platform): Experiment phases: deterministic hash by tenant_id. Phases: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20%. Each phase min duration 2h and 2 steady-state windows.

Sam (eng-runtime): Example rollout config (will add to PRD):
```json
{
  "rollout": {
    "phases": [
      {"pct": 0.5, "min_duration_mins": 120},
      {"pct": 5, "min_duration_mins": 120},
      {"pct": 20, "min_duration_mins": 120}
    ],
    "pinning": {"tenant_pin_enabled": true}
  }
}
```

Ravi (eng-sre): Monitoring: define baselines and alerts. Need automated metric checks for regressions and a synthetic user journey to validate correctness every 5m.

release-bot: Deployment window reserved: 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z. CI: green. Please tag owners in PR.

Maya (product): OK — I'll update the PRD with this language and tag @Eli @Sam @Ravi @Jana. Quick reactions pls :thumbsup: or :neutral_face: by EOD.
